title: MIRAGE: domain-adaptive simulation-based inference for JWST exoplanet atmospheric retrieval
description: Code, reduced JWST transmission spectra, trained flow-matching posterior-estimation (FMPE) models, and posterior samples for MIRAGE — a simulation-based inference pipeline for exoplanet atmospheric retrieval built on radius inference and optimal-transport calibration. Includes real-data retrievals for three planets spanning a hot Saturn to a cold sub-Neptune: WASP-39b (NIRSpec PRISM), WASP-96b (NIRISS SOSS, self-reduced end-to-end from the raw MAST ramps with exoTEDRF), and K2-18b (NIRISS). Each retrieval is validated against an independent nested-sampling retrieval in the same parameter space. The radius-inference + flow method recovers the planet radius and a water-rich atmosphere across planet class, instrument, and data provenance.
